question: Should a dismissed failed-cron chip resurface when the same job fails again after a recovery that no open Control UI tab observed?
rationale: Job-ID-only signatures avoid repeated nags for a continuously failing scheduled job but cannot distinguish a later incident unless an active UI observes and prunes the recovered state, making the re-arm behavior a user-facing snooze-policy choice.

options.title: Re-arm per incident
options.body: Include a stable failure incident or run identity so a later failure resurfaces while a continuously failing job remains dismissed.

options.title: Expire dismissals
options.body: Keep job-ID signatures but apply a bounded dismissal lifetime that eventually resurfaces persistent and later failures.

options.title: Accept observed-clear semantics
options.body: Document that failed-cron dismissals re-arm only when an active UI observes recovery, accepting that offline recurrence may remain hidden.

recommendation.title: Re-arm per incident
recommendation.body: Include a stable failure incident or run identity so a later failure resurfaces while a continuously failing job remains dismissed.
